synthesis: Remove the admin-only Debug map control (DebugMapControls.vue) from the Clarity Scout live-driver map. The popover (gated by config app.scanner_debug_map_enabled / env SCANNER_DEBUG_MAP_ENABLED, default false) lets an admin/impersonator pick a geohash precision (6-9, forwarded as a `precision` query param to the CH heatmap endpoints) and toggle a satellite basemap. Normal drivers never see it. The ticket poses an explicit A/B fork: (A) delete only the UI control + wiring, leave backend plumbing dormant; (B, recommended) full removal incl. backend precision path, config flag, satellite swap. Two findings beyond the ticket text: (1) the config flag is NOT reachable only through the control — ClarityScoutMapController::scanPaths() reads the same flag to enable per-hour scan-path debug coloring via HistoricPathBuilder (DEV-2018), a separately-tested feature with no UI tie to the popover; deleting the flag silently kills it. (2) A correctness trap: the CH query classes default to precision 6 (not 7) when the param is absent, so Option B must hardcode precision=7 at the call sites, not merely delete the param, or the AC 'precision-7 unchanged' regresses.

questions.q: Scope A vs B: (A) remove only the UI control + wiring and leave backend precision/satellite plumbing dormant, or (B, ticket-recommended) full removal of the backend precision param path, the scanner_debug_map_enabled flag, and the satellite basemap swap?
questions.answer: B — full removal of the popover UI + backend precision param path + satellite basemap swap.

questions.q: If Option B: the scanner_debug_map_enabled flag ALSO gates ClarityScoutMapController::scanPaths() per-hour scan-path debug coloring via HistoricPathBuilder (DEV-2018) — a feature with NO UI connection to the Debug popover, separately unit- and feature-tested. Should we (a) remove that scan-path debug coloring too, or (b) preserve it?
questions.answer: Keep the flag for scanPaths only — leave config/app.php scanner_debug_map_enabled in place and do NOT touch scanPaths()/HistoricPathBuilder. Full Option B applies to the popover/precision/satellite path only; the flag survives to gate the scan-path debug coloring.

questions.q: Bird's Eye controller also uses resolveDebugPrecision() (not in the ticket's reference list) — treat it identically under B?
questions.answer: Yes — same shared trait method; will be updated in the same change so no broken reference remains.

questions.q: Does deleting the `precision` param (vs hardcoding 7) preserve precision-7?
questions.answer: No — HitDirectHotspotQuery & HotlistAddressGeohashQuery fall back to 6 (?? 6) when precision is absent. Option B must explicitly pass precision=7 at the call sites.
